name: What's the difference between double-hung and single-hung windows?
description: Double-hung windows allow both sashes to open, offering better ventilation and cleaning, while single-hung only allow the bottom sash to move.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between double-hung and single-hung windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between double-hung and single-hung windows lies in their functionality. In a double-hung window, both the top and bottom sashes can be opened and tilted, offering more ventilation options and easier cleaning. Single-hung windows, conversely, only allow the bottom sash to move. A practical tradeoff is that while single-hung windows are generally less expensive upfront, double-hung windows offer greater convenience and often better energy efficiency, which can lead to long-term savings and comfort.
